_doc: Phase 8c candidate config — three different strategy CLASSES (not just Donchian variants) on BTC. Backtest-only.

_hypothesis.rsi_mean_reversion_1h: Donchian failed on chop. RSI mean-reversion is the opposite: it WORKS in choppy markets, fails in trends. If RSI gives positive Sharpe OOS, we have a complementary edge to BTC 4h Donchian — they're negatively correlated by design.
_hypothesis.squeeze_momentum_4h: Bollinger-inside-Keltner detects compression; the breakout direction is confirmed by linear-regression momentum. Different signal logic than Donchian breakout — catches the EXPANSION after low-vola periods, not just new highs.
_hypothesis.tema_cross_4h_long: Triple-EMA crossover (5/13/34) with long-EMA trend filter. Same Long-only constraint as Phase 8a, but the entry/exit logic is smoother than Donchian (no abrupt channel breaks, gradual EMA cross). Tests whether the BTC edge is in the indicator or in the timeframe.
